name: Big-Math
title: Big-Math: A Large-Scale, High-Quality Math Dataset for Reinforcement Learning in Language Models
summary_en: Filters 251K problems with unique closed-form answers and rewrites multiple-choice questions into open-ended, answer-verifiable form for RL.
summary_zh: 筛出约 25 万道答案唯一、可闭式校验的数学题，并把选择题改写为可验证的开放题，用于 RL。

name: DeepMath-103K
title: DeepMath-103K: A Large-Scale, Challenging, Decontaminated, and Verifiable Mathematical Dataset for Advancing Reasoning
summary_en: 103K hard, decontaminated math problems, each with a verifiable final answer for rule-based RL rewards.
summary_zh: 10.3 万道高难度、去污染的数学题，每题带可规则校验的最终答案。

name: DeepTheorem
title: DeepTheorem: Advancing LLM Reasoning for Theorem Proving Through Natural Language and Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Builds true/false variants of 121K informal theorems so that proving yields a checkable truth-value reward.
summary_zh: 为 12.1 万条非形式定理构造真/假变体，使“证明”转化为可校验的真值奖励。

name: SwS
title: SwS: Self-aware Weakness-driven Problem Synthesis in Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
summary_en: Synthesizes new verifiable problems from concepts behind questions the policy keeps failing during RL.
summary_zh: 提取策略在 RL 中反复失败题目背后的概念，合成新的可验证题。

name: RV-Syn
title: RV-Syn: Rational and Verifiable Mathematical Reasoning Data Synthesis based on Structured Function Library
summary_en: Composes library functions into executable computation graphs and back-translates them into problems whose answers come from execution.
summary_zh: 把函数库组合成可执行计算图并反译成题目，执行计算图即得真值答案。

name: MathSmith
title: MathSmith: Towards Extremely Hard Mathematical Reasoning by Forging Synthetic Problems with a Reinforced Policy
summary_en: An RL-trained generator forges hard problems from scratch, rewarded for structural validity, difficulty and answer consistency.
summary_zh: 用 RL 训练的出题器从零合成难题，奖励兼顾结构有效性、难度与答案一致性。

name: PromptCoT 2.0
title: PromptCoT 2.0: Scaling Prompt Synthesis for Large Language Model Reasoning
summary_en: An EM loop refines rationales to synthesize harder math and code prompts for training with verifiable feedback.
summary_zh: 以 EM 循环迭代优化推理依据，合成更难的数学与代码题，用于基于可验证反馈的训练。

name: CoT-Self-Instruct
title: CoT-Self-Instruct: Building high-quality synthetic prompts for reasoning and non-reasoning tasks
summary_en: LLMs plan with CoT to write new single-answer problems, kept only if majority-vote answers are consistent, for RLVR.
summary_zh: LLM 先用 CoT 规划再生成单值答案的新题，经多数投票一致性过滤后用于 RLVR。

name: MagicBeanStalk
title: MagicBeanStalk: Escaping the RLVR Zero Advantage Trap with Recursive Data Synthesis
summary_en: Decomposes hard seeds top-down and recursively composes new verifiable problems bottom-up, calibrated to the policy's difficulty.
summary_zh: 自顶向下拆解难题，再自底向上递归组合出新的可验证题，并按策略能力校准难度。

name: SHARP
title: SHARP: Synthesizing High-quality Aligned Reasoning Problems for Large Reasoning Models Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: A strong reasoning model synthesizes graduate/Olympiad STEM problems constrained to unique numeric or symbolic answers for binary rewards.
summary_zh: 由强推理模型合成研究生/奥赛级 STEM 题，并约束答案为唯一数值或符号，以获得二值奖励。

name: Dr. SCI
title: Improving Data and Reward Design for Scientific Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary_en: Processes open science data into 1M STEM questions with explicit verifiable vs. open-ended splits and difficulty labels.
summary_zh: 将开源科学数据处理为 100 万道 STEM 题，显式区分可验证与开放部分并标注难度。

name: BioAlchemy
title: BioAlchemy: Distilling Biological Literature into Reasoning-Ready Reinforcement Learning Training Data
summary_en: Extracts 345K answer-verifiable questions from biology papers, aligned to the PubMed topic distribution, for RLVR.
summary_zh: 从生物学论文中抽取 34.5 万道可验证题，并按 PubMed 主题分布对齐，用于 RLVR。

name: ether0
title: Training a Scientific Reasoning Model for Chemistry
summary_en: RL on 640K experimentally grounded chemistry problems with open-source programmatic reward functions that check molecules.
summary_zh: 在 64 万道以实验为依据的化学题上做 RL，以开源的程序化奖励函数校验分子答案。

name: Med-RLVR
title: Med-RLVR: Emerging Medical Reasoning from a 3B base model via reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Uses gold labels of medical multiple-choice QA as rule-checkable rewards to elicit medical reasoning via RLVR.
summary_zh: 以医学多选题的标准答案作为可规则校验的奖励，通过 RLVR 激发医学推理。

name: OwkinZero
title: OwkinZero: Accelerating Biological Discovery with AI
summary_en: Curates 300K+ biology QA pairs whose labels come from deterministic pipelines such as expression tests and druggability scores.
summary_zh: 整理 30 万余条生物问答，标签来自表达检验、成药性打分等确定性流程。

name: P1
title: P1: Mastering Physics Olympiads with Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Curates Olympiad and textbook physics problems with rule-verifiable final answers (types, units) to train physics reasoners with RL.
summary_zh: 整理奥赛与教材物理题并标注可规则校验的最终答案（类型、单位），以 RL 训练物理推理模型。

name: General-Reasoner
title: General-Reasoner: Advancing LLM Reasoning Across All Domains
summary_en: Re-crawls web sources to recover human answers, keeping 230K cross-domain questions with short verifiable answers.
summary_zh: 回溯网页取回人工答案，保留 23 万道跨学科、短答案可验证的题目。

name: Nemotron-CrossThink
title: Nemotron-CrossThink: Scaling Self-Learning beyond Math Reasoning
summary_en: Templates multi-domain QA into multiple-choice or short open answers and filters for verifiability, enabling rule-based rewards beyond math.
summary_zh: 把多领域问答套成选择题或短答题并过滤可验证性，使数学之外也能使用规则奖励。

name: Guru
title: Revisiting Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning from A Cross-Domain Perspective
summary_en: 92K verifiable examples across math, code, science, logic, simulation and tables, each domain with its own reward design and filtering.
summary_zh: 覆盖数学、代码、科学、逻辑、模拟、表格 6 个领域的 9.2 万条可验证样本，各领域单独设计奖励与过滤。

name: Webscale-RL
title: Webscale-RL: Automated Data Pipeline for Scaling RL Data to Pretraining Levels
summary_en: Converts pretraining documents into 1.2M verifiable QA pairs across 9+ domains via filtering, persona-driven generation and checking.
summary_zh: 经过滤、角色驱动生成与校验，把预训练文档转换为 120 万条跨 9+ 领域的可验证问答。

name: Golden Goose
title: Golden Goose: A Simple Trick to Synthesize Unlimited RLVR Tasks from Unverifiable Internet Text
summary_en: Masks key reasoning spans in unverifiable text and adds distractors, turning corpora into multiple-choice fill-in-the-middle tasks with exact-match rewards.
summary_zh: 遮蔽不可验证文本中的关键推理片段并加入干扰项，把语料变为可精确匹配的中间填空选择题。

name: Loong
title: Loong: Synthesize Long Chain-of-Thoughts at Scale through Verifiers
summary_en: Human-vetted seeds with executable code across 12 domains; synthesized question-answer-code triples reward CoT matching the code-executed answer.
summary_zh: 12 个领域、配可执行代码的人工审核种子；合成问题-答案-代码三元组，CoT 结果与代码执行答案一致即得奖励。

name: Synthetic Data RL
title: Synthetic Data RL: Task Definition Is All You Need
summary_en: Generates verifiable QA pairs from only a task definition and retrieved passages, adapting difficulty and selecting by pass rate before RL.
summary_zh: 仅凭任务定义与检索段落生成可验证问答，调整难度并按通过率筛选后用于 RL。

name: TACO
title: TACO: Topics in Algorithmic COde generation dataset
summary_en: 26K algorithmic problems with I/O test cases, a widely reused execution-verifiable source for code RL.
summary_zh: 2.6 万道带输入输出测试的算法题，是代码 RL 中被广泛复用的可执行验证数据源。

name: AceCoder
title: ACECODER: Acing Coder RL via Automated Test-Case Synthesis
summary_en: LLM-synthesized test cases filtered by execution turn seed questions into 87K verifiable problems; pass rates serve as RL rewards.
summary_zh: 由 LLM 合成测试用例并经执行过滤，得到 8.7 万道可验证题，通过率直接作为 RL 奖励。

name: KodCode
title: KodCode: A Diverse, Challenging, and Verifiable Synthetic Dataset for Coding
summary_en: Synthesizes 447K question-solution-unit-test triplets self-verified by execution, providing unit tests ready for RL rewards.
summary_zh: 合成 44.7 万组经执行自验证的“题目-解答-单元测试”三元组，单测可直接作为 RL 奖励。

name: LeetCodeDataset
title: LeetCodeDataset: A Temporal Dataset for Robust Evaluation and Efficient Training of Code LLMs
summary_en: LeetCode Python problems with verified canonical solutions and 100+ tests each, plus a temporal split for contamination-free training.
summary_zh: LeetCode Python 题，每题配经验证的标准解与 100+ 测试，并按时间切分以避免污染。

name: rStar-Coder
title: rStar-Coder: Scaling Competitive Code Reasoning with a Large-Scale Verified Dataset
summary_en: Three-step input generation plus mutual verification across solutions labels outputs, yielding 418K competition problems with verified tests.
summary_zh: 三步式输入生成加多解互验标注输出，构建 41.8 万道带验证测试的竞赛题。

name: HardTests
title: HardTests: Synthesizing High-Quality Test Cases for LLM Coding
summary_en: LLM-written input validators, generators and hacking inputs with oracle outputs build 47K problems with stronger tests.
summary_zh: 由 LLM 编写输入校验器、生成器与针对性输入，并以标准程序给出输出，构建 4.7 万道强测试题。

name: CodeContests+
title: CodeContests+: High-Quality Test Case Generation for Competitive Programming
summary_en: An LLM agent writes generators, validators and checkers for 11.7K problems, measured against 1.72M real submissions.
summary_zh: LLM 智能体为 1.17 万道竞赛题编写生成器、校验器与判题器，并用 172 万份真实提交评估质量。

name: SAGA
title: Rethinking Verification for LLM Code Generation: From Generation to Testing
summary_en: Human-LLM test generation mines correct and incorrect human submissions to build discriminative test suites for more accurate RLVR rewards.
summary_zh: 人机协同生成测试，分析人类正确与错误提交以构造区分力强的测试集，使 RLVR 奖励更准确。

name: Klear-CodeTest
title: Klear-CodeTest: Scalable Test Case Generation for Code Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: A generator-validation framework produces regular and corner-case tests checked against multiple gold solutions, with a secure sandbox for rewards.
summary_zh: 生成-校验框架产出常规与边界测试，并以多份标准解做一致性校验，配套安全沙箱计算奖励。

name: CURE
title: Co-Evolving LLM Coder and Unit Tester via Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Coder and unit tester co-evolve via RL from their interaction outcomes without ground-truth code; the tester then supplies rewards.
summary_zh: 编码器与单测生成器依据彼此交互结果经 RL 共同进化，无需标准代码，训练出的测试器可提供奖励。

name: UTRL
title: Learning to Generate Unit Test via Adversarial Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: A test generator is rewarded for tests that pass gold code but fail generated code, trained adversarially against a coder.
summary_zh: 测试生成器写出“标准代码通过、生成代码失败”的测试即得奖励，并与编码器对抗训练。

name: AutoCode
title: AutoCode: LLMs as Problem Setters for Competitive Programming
summary_en: A validator-generator-checker loop yields test suites about 99% consistent with official verdicts, designed as low-false-positive RLVR verifiers.
summary_zh: 校验器-生成器-判题器闭环生成与官方判题约 99% 一致的测试集，作为低假阳性的 RLVR 验证器。

name: X-Coder
title: X-Coder: Advancing Competitive Programming with Synthetic Tasks, Solutions, and Tests
summary_en: Fully synthetic competitive tasks with tests cross-checked by dual verification of solutions and outputs, giving 40K RL tasks.
summary_zh: 全合成竞赛题，测试经“解答+输出”双重验证，提供 4 万道 RL 任务。

name: CodeContests-O
title: CodeContests-O: Powering LLMs via Feedback-Driven Iterative Test Case Generation
summary_en: Runs generated tests against known correct and incorrect solutions and feeds failures back to refine generators iteratively.
summary_zh: 把生成的测试在已知正确与错误解上运行，并将失败反馈给 LLM 迭代改进生成器。

name: Code-A1
title: Code-A1: Adversarial Evolving of Code LLM and Test LLM via Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: A code LLM and a white-box test LLM with opposing rewards co-evolve, producing adversarial tests that rival human tests as RL rewards.
summary_zh: 代码模型与白盒测试模型以相反奖励对抗进化，生成的对抗测试作为 RL 奖励可媲美人工测试。

name: RobustTests
title: Robust Code RL via Faulty-Code-Driven Test case Synthesis and Dense Reward Shaping
summary_en: Near-correct faulty programs drive test synthesis, filtered by validator agents and clustering, to reduce false positives and negatives.
summary_zh: 以近似正确的错误程序驱动测试合成，并经校验智能体与聚类过滤，降低假阳性与假阴性。

name: TCS
title: Two-Stage Reinforcement Learning for Sound and Adversarial Test Generation in Code LLMs
summary_en: Two-stage RL trains a test generator first for tests consistent with references, then for counterexamples targeting solver failures.
summary_zh: 两阶段 RL：先训练与参考解一致的测试生成，再针对求解器的失败模式生成反例。

name: DeepSeek-Prover
title: DeepSeek-Prover: Advancing Theorem Proving in LLMs through Large-Scale Synthetic Data
summary_en: Autoformalizes competition problems into Lean 4 and keeps only Lean-verified proofs, yielding 8M verified statement-proof pairs.
summary_zh: 把竞赛题自动形式化为 Lean 4，仅保留经 Lean 校验的证明，得到约 800 万条已验证的命题-证明对。

name: Lean Workbook
title: Lean Workbook: A large-scale Lean problem set formalized from natural language math problems
summary_en: Iterative autoformalization with Lean compile filtering and back-translation checks yields ~57K formal-informal problem pairs.
summary_zh: 以 Lean 编译过滤与回译校验迭代自动形式化，得到约 5.7 万条形式/非形式题对。

name: LEAN-GitHub
title: LEAN-GitHub: Compiling GitHub LEAN repositories for a versatile LEAN prover
summary_en: Compiles nearly all Lean 4 GitHub repositories to extract compiler-checked tactic states and steps as verified training data.
summary_zh: 编译几乎全部 GitHub 上的 Lean 4 仓库，抽取经编译器确认的策略状态与步骤作为已验证训练数据。

name: DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5
title: DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5: Harnessing Proof Assistant Feedback for Reinforcement Learning and Monte-Carlo Tree Search
summary_en: Uses Lean 4 compiler pass/fail on generated proofs as the RL reward (RLPAF), combined with exploration-driven tree search.
summary_zh: 以 Lean 4 编译器对证明的通过/失败作为 RL 奖励（RLPAF），并结合探索驱动的树搜索。

name: InternLM2.5-StepProver
title: InternLM2.5-StepProver: Advancing Automated Theorem Proving via Critic-Guided Search
summary_en: Large-scale expert iteration on Lean Workbook; Lean-verified searched proofs retrain the prover and critic and are released.
summary_zh: 在 Lean Workbook 上进行大规模专家迭代，以经 Lean 验证的搜索证明重训证明器与评估器，并公开证明。

name: Herald
title: Herald: A Natural Language Annotated Lean 4 Dataset
summary_en: Back-translates Mathlib4 into ~580K aligned NL-Lean pairs; the translator is checked by Lean compilation plus back-translation.
summary_zh: 将 Mathlib4 回译为约 58 万条对齐的自然语言-Lean 对，翻译器经 Lean 编译与回译校验。

name: Alchemy
title: Alchemy: Amplifying Theorem-Proving Capability through Symbolic Mutation
summary_en: Symbolically mutates Mathlib theorems via rewrite/apply with invocable lemmas, expanding 110K to 6M Lean-checked theorems.
summary_zh: 借助可调用引理对 Mathlib 定理做符号变异，把 11 万条扩充为 600 万条经 Lean 校验的定理。

name: STP
title: STP: Self-play LLM Theorem Provers with Iterative Conjecturing and Proving
summary_en: A conjecturer proposes barely provable conjectures and a prover attempts them; formal verification rewards both, densifying sparse signals.
summary_zh: 猜想者提出“刚好可证”的猜想，证明者尝试证明，形式化校验同时奖励两者，缓解奖励稀疏。

name: Goedel-Prover
title: Goedel-Prover: A Frontier Model for Open-Source Automated Theorem Proving
summary_en: Autoformalizes 1.64M Lean statements and accumulates 800K+ Lean-verified proofs through iterative expert iteration.
summary_zh: 自动形式化 164 万条 Lean 命题，并通过多轮专家迭代累积 80 万余条经 Lean 验证的证明。

name: Leanabell-Prover
title: Leanabell-Prover: Posttraining Scaling in Formal Reasoning
summary_en: Continual training on statement-proof pairs followed by RL with Lean 4 compiler outcome rewards; releases 140K formal statements.
summary_zh: 先在命题-证明对上继续训练，再以 Lean 4 编译器结果奖励做 RL，公开 14 万条形式命题。

name: Kimina-Prover
title: Kimina-Prover Preview: Towards Large Formal Reasoning Models with Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Autoformalized and human-annotated Lean statements form the RL prompt set; a Lean server returns binary proof-correctness rewards.
summary_zh: 自动形式化与人工标注的 Lean 命题构成 RL 题池，由 Lean 服务返回证明正误的二值奖励。

name: DeepSeek-Prover-V2
title: DeepSeek-Prover-V2: Advancing Formal Mathematical Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning for Subgoal Decomposition
summary_en: Decomposes theorems into Lean subgoals; Lean-verified subgoal proofs form cold-start data, followed by RL with binary verification rewards.
summary_zh: 把定理分解为 Lean 子目标，经 Lean 校验的子目标证明拼合为冷启动数据，再以二值校验奖励做 RL。

name: CriticLean
title: CriticLean: Critic-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Mathematical Formalization
summary_en: Lean compilation plus an RL-trained semantic critic refine autoformalizations, yielding 285K compile- and critic-verified statements.
summary_zh: Lean 编译检查加 RL 训练的语义评估器迭代修正自动形式化，得到 28.5 万条双重校验的命题。

name: Goedel-Prover-V2
title: Goedel-Prover-V2: Scaling Formal Theorem Proving with Scaffolded Data Synthesis and Self-Correction
summary_en: Scaffolded synthesis of progressively harder Lean tasks plus self-correction from Lean compiler feedback within expert iteration and RL.
summary_zh: 渐进式合成难度递增的 Lean 任务，并在专家迭代与 RL 中利用 Lean 编译反馈自我修正。

name: FormaRL
title: FormaRL: Enhancing Autoformalization with no Labeled Data
summary_en: RL for autoformalization with rewards from Lean syntax checks and consistency checks, using only a few hundred unlabeled problems.
summary_zh: 面向自动形式化的 RL，奖励来自 Lean 语法检查与一致性检查，仅需数百道无标注题。

name: PhysProver
title: PhysProver: Advancing Automatic Theorem Proving for Physics
summary_en: Builds physics Lean data from PhysLean theorems plus synthesized conjectures, then RLVR with Lean-verified proof rewards.
summary_zh: 由 PhysLean 定理与合成猜想构建物理 Lean 数据，再以 Lean 验证的证明奖励做 RLVR。

name: OProver
title: OProver: A Unified Framework for Agentic Formal Theorem Proving
summary_en: An agentic proving loop with Lean feedback builds 1.77M statements and 6.86M compiler-verified proofs with repair trajectories.
summary_zh: 借助 Lean 反馈的智能体证明循环，构建 177 万命题与 686 万条编译器验证的证明及修复轨迹。

name: MathForm
title: MathForm: Scaling Mathematical Autoformalization with Knowledge Retrieval and Verification-Guided Refinement
summary_en: Mathlib-retrieval-guided autoformalization refined by compiler diagnostics and semantic feedback builds ~367K verified Lean examples.
summary_zh: 检索 Mathlib 引导自动形式化，并以编译诊断与语义反馈修正，构建约 36.7 万条已验证的 Lean 样本。

name: AutoIF
title: Self-play with Execution Feedback: Improving Instruction-following Capabilities of Large Language Models
summary_en: LLMs self-generate instructions, Python verification functions and unit tests; execution feedback filters responses into training signals.
summary_zh: LLM 自行生成指令、Python 校验函数与单元测试，以执行反馈筛选回复，得到指令遵循训练信号。

name: MulDimIF
title: MulDimIF: A Multi-Dimensional Constraint Framework for Evaluating and Improving Instruction Following in Large Language Models
summary_en: A controllable pipeline of constraint expansion, conflict detection and rewriting builds code-verifiable samples whose scripts serve as GRPO rewards.
summary_zh: 通过约束扩展、冲突检测与改写可控生成可代码校验的样本，校验脚本直接作为 GRPO 奖励。

name: RECAST
title: RECAST: Expanding the Boundaries of LLMs' Complex Instruction Following with Multi-Constraint Data
summary_en: Mines constraints from real prompt-response pairs into 30K instances; rule and LLM validators give per-constraint RL rewards.
summary_zh: 从真实指令-回复对中挖掘约束，构造 3 万条多约束数据，规则与 LLM 校验器逐条约束给出 RL 奖励。

name: RAIF
title: Incentivizing Reasoning for Advanced Instruction-Following of Large Language Models
summary_en: Decomposes complex compositional instructions into data with rule-centric verifiable rewards, using RL to cultivate reasoning for instruction following.
summary_zh: 把复杂组合指令分解为配有规则型可验证奖励的数据，用 RL 培养指令遵循中的推理。

name: VerIF
title: VerIF: Verification Engineering for Reinforcement Learning in Instruction Following
summary_en: Hybrid rewards: code checks for hard constraints plus reasoning-LLM checks for soft ones; releases ~22K instructions with verification signals.
summary_zh: 混合奖励：硬约束用代码校验、软约束用推理模型校验；发布约 2.2 万条带校验信号的指令。

name: IFBench
title: Generalizing Verifiable Instruction Following
summary_en: Releases new training constraints with Python verification functions and IF-RLVR prompts; programmatic checks serve as RLVR rewards.
summary_zh: 发布新的训练约束及 Python 校验函数和 IF-RLVR 训练集，以程序化约束检查作为 RLVR 奖励。

name: IFDecorator
title: IFDECORATOR: Wrapping Instruction Following Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary_en: A cooperative-adversarial flywheel co-evolves instructions and hybrid verifications; intent checks and trap instructions curb reward hacking.
summary_zh: 协作-对抗数据飞轮让指令与混合校验共同进化，意图检查与陷阱指令抑制奖励投机。

name: MIFS
title: Towards Scalable RLVR: Multimodal Instruction Following Data Synthesis and Distillation
summary_en: Synthesizes 90K multimodal constraint instructions, each mapped to executable checker code and filtered by RL learnability.
summary_zh: 合成 9 万条多模态约束指令，每条约束对应可执行检查代码，并按 RL 可学性筛选。

name: CaLIF
title: Diagnosing and Correcting Reward Hacking in Verifiable Instruction Following
summary_en: Shows constraint-checker rewards induce empty but compliant responses, and calibrates them with a reference-policy likelihood bonus.
summary_zh: 指出约束检查奖励会诱导“满足约束但答非所问”的回复，并以参考策略似然加以校准。

name: TinyV
title: TinyV: Reducing False Negatives in Verification Improves RL for LLM Reasoning
summary_en: Finds many verifier false negatives in RL; a small model re-checks rule-rejected answers to recover correct rewards.
summary_zh: 发现 RL 中规则验证器存在大量假阴性，用小模型复核被规则判错的答案以找回正确奖励。

name: Rule-vs-Model Verifiers
title: From Accuracy to Robustness: A Study of Rule- and Model-based Verifiers in Mathematical Reasoning
summary_en: Rule-based verifiers miss equivalent answers, while model-based verifiers get hacked during RL; analyzes both failure modes.
summary_zh: 规则验证器认不出等价答案（假阴性），模型验证器在 RL 中被钻空子（假阳性），系统分析两类失效。

name: Noisy-Verifier RLVR
title: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable yet Noisy Rewards under Imperfect Verifiers
summary_en: Models verifier errors as an asymmetric false-positive/negative noise channel and corrects for it to recover clean policy gradients.
summary_zh: 把验证器错误建模为不对称的假阳/假阴噪声通道，并加以校正以恢复干净的策略梯度。
